steps.content: A card comes flying into a small gallery on the city's outskirts.
Whoosh!
On its pure white paper, a red cat emblem gleams, its bewitching eye glinting with mischief.
In the blank space beside it, an elegant message declares:
Tonight at 12 PM, we will come to claim the final piece of the Otherland Angels.
Now, at nightfall, about a dozen sheriffs stand at attention inside that same gallery, awaiting your orders.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The plan is straightforward. They only have one way in and out. Lock it down, and we cut off their escape.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Each of you, cover a cardinal point. The moment you spot the suspects, pursue them immediately!

steps.speaker: Sheriffs
steps.content: Roger that!
The sheriffs fan out, moving silently to their assigned positions at strategic vantage points.
The minutes trickle past. Suddenly, a frigid gust of winter air invades the space, making you shiver involuntarily.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Feels like... snow is coming.
A sudden, cold speck lands on your nose. As you look up, a cascade of white, fluffy particles begins to descend, filling the air.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: It's the vents! Chief, watch out!!
Countless white particles stream from the vents like a sudden, indoor snow squall, proving your earlier prediction of snow correct—just ahead of schedule.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: This... This stuff... Something's not right...
A series of heavy thuds echoes as the sheriffs slump to the floor. The realization hits you: the drifting particles are a frozen chemical agent, a paralytic that activates when inhaled.
You press your sleeve against your mouth, fighting a sudden, swimming dizziness. Your gaze locks onto the ventilation shaft.
As the terminal blinks to 00:00, a violent crack sounds from the ceiling above you.
You think we'd come unprepared?

The ventilation duct flies open, blasting a new wave of frozen particles through the gallery. Other sheriffs charge in at the sound of the noise, only to breathe in the thawed agent and drop where they stand.
That vent wasn't originally set to blow in this direction. It doesn't take much to figure out who hijacked the gallery's central control system.
I've told you so many times, Chief. There are certain gadgets you need to carry, whether you like them or not.
You feel a simple mask being settled over your face. Through the messy veil of your hair, you see the rabbit-masked Sinner's wink. Then she bounces toward the ventilation duct, her arms thrown wide.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Well, well! Miss Phantom Kitty, fancy meeting you here!
The last of the frozen particles from the vent have fallen, though a cold wind continues to pour in. And descending along with that wind is a figure clad in blue.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: What a pleasant surprise, Miss Rabbit. It seems I'll be taking this painting right from under your nose. Again.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: You're welcome to try!
Kisugi Hitomi pulls out a gadget her little sister gave her and hurls it toward Pricilla.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Oh my, you missed!
Pricilla sidesteps the attack with fluid grace. Coming to a rest, she shakes her head, her expression one of exaggerated pity.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: On the contrary. I hit exactly what I aimed for.

The small black ball bounces twice before snapping onto the glass protecting the painting. An ear-splitting sound then hits, pounding directly into your mind no matter how tightly you cover your ears.
Then, the entire security case fractures and dissolves into a shower of glittering fragments.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Alright, then! Time to get serious!
Pricilla moves in a flash, blocking Kisugi Hitomi's advance toward the artwork. She sweeps the floor, gathering broken glass, which she sends flying like a lethal spray.
Kisugi Hitomi staggers backward to escape the glittering onslaught.
With Cat's Eye pinned by Pricilla and Tetra, and everyone's attention momentarily scattered…
A deafening explosion tears through the venue.

The far wall collapses as if hit by a charge, opening into a pitch-black chasm. Figures in tactical black rip through the darkness, surging in like a torrent. Their movements are sharper, colder, and far more coordinated than any previous intruders. Here they come: the notorious Marauders.

steps.speaker: Marauder
steps.content: Ha! Excellent work, you nameless strays. And you, the self-righteous jailer! Let your lukewarm justice perish here, along with this priceless prize!

The heinous criminal raises a weapon unlike any standard firearm. It pulses with an ominous black glow, pushing the room's tension past its breaking point. Pricilla and Tetra snap into defensive stances, their movements pure instinct.

But the enemy's cold stare fixates on the prized painting, and on Cat's Eye. The gallery erupts into instant chaos, a storm of blood and smoke. Without a moment's hesitation, you step forward to shield everyone—
Suddenly, a pair of warm arms wrap around you from behind, accompanied by a soft, familiar scent. A gentle, melodic voice comes intimately close to your ear, the vibration of it almost tangible.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: I've always admired your hands, Chief. The way you hold a coffee cup... it's quite arresting.
Kisugi Rui's hands clamp down on your wrists, her fingers locking with surprising strength. You strain, but her hold barely yields.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Restraining me is pointless.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: How kind of you to worry. But we'll be just fine. Please... stay still for a moment.
The exhibition hall plunges into sudden, absolute blackness.
When your vision returns, an elegant ribbon bow holds your wrists together.

Your intervention proves unnecessary. Before the Marauder's gun can spit fire—or rather, at the very instant the muzzle flashes—Cat's Eye becomes a blur. A lightning-fast impact shatters the criminal's mind, sending his body slumping lifelessly to the floor.

Then, in the breath between the strike and the silence, a faint breeze stirs the empty air where the painting stood. The final prize is gone. Cat's Eye has concluded the performance, down to the last, perfect detail.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Nice work, Rui! Quick, take it away!

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Don't you underestimate me!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Careful now! Pull any harder and these pointy ears of yours are coming right off!

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Ah... F-fine! This mask is custom-made...

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Hey, sly fox! Do something already!
Three seconds of heavy silence pass. Then, a sharp crackle of static breaks from the speakers.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: I've done plenty, little rabbit.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: That little kitty couldn't penetrate my updated firewall. I fortified the entire network after our last encounter. However, she physically breached the security system and infiltrated the exhibition hall.

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: While she failed to breach my digital defenses, she probably deduced my countermeasures. So, as a professional phantom thief... she must have mustered considerable resolve to proceed with the physical gambit—
Before the words are fully out, a figure clad in orange blasts free from the duct, her disruptive power active. The entire venue's systems instantly fail.
The lights extinguish. The ventilation grates go quiet. Every shrill alarm that had been echoing since the breach is suddenly, utterly mute.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Our thanks for your spirited participation.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: The final piece of the Otherland Angels belongs to us now.

Clutching the canvas, Kisugi Rui releases a cluster of the small black balls. The same high-frequency shriek rips through the air, and in an instant, all the surrounding windows burst apart. The three sisters dive through the openings, melting into the cold, rushing darkness.
Pricilla flicks a few glittering fragments from her shoulder and approaches. Then, she begins to loosen the ribbon binding your hands.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: Back in my prime, I never let a score slip away like that. A first-time failure!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Well... technically, you're a Bureau Sinner now. On the official payroll.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So you could consider tonight not a failure of the great Phantom Robber "Pricilla," but... an operational oversight by a Bureau employee.

steps.speaker: Pricilla
steps.content: You silver-tongued devil!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ow! D-don't kick me...

steps.speaker: Tetra
steps.content: Chief, this isn't over yet, right? Rabbit and I can handle the mess here. You should probably head back to the café.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll leave it in your hands then. Thanks.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Oh, and... send those photos to Wynn. Tell her to run the "publicity stunt" cover story. She's got a knack for knowing just where to post to get people chatting.
